name: llm_sft
description: "LLM + SFT" generation baseline: an open LLM (default Qwen/Qwen3-8B; Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct / Qwen3-4B / Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct via config base_model) LoRA-fine-tuned on a dialogue dataset's train split (train.py), then generating the next turn greedily (<=50 new tokens). The standard 2025-26 comparison point for multi-party (DRCR, ACL 2026), long-term (LD-Agent, NAACL 2025) and persona (PAL 2025) generation alike; one prompt function shared by training and inference. Needs the sft extra and a GPU.
author: Wnsdnl
